Ref. No. PURCM/2026/4070 Dated: 05.10.2026
NOTICE
The Walk-In-Interviews for appointing Guest Faculty to teach at Panjab University Regional
Centre, Sri Muktsar Sahib for the Academic Session 2026-27 (Odd Semester) for the following
subject will be held in the Selection Committee Room (First Floor) of Rajiv Gandhi Bhawan,
Panjab University, Chandigarh as per the following schedule:
Date Subject No. of vacancies Time
15.10.2026 English 1 11:00 AM
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professors available on Panjab
University website (https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018) (Page 1 to 9). The
candidates should bring all their original certificates and other relevant documents along with the
duly filled application forms and attested copies of all the certificates/ documents (Two copies
each) and two passport size photographs.
 The above assignment is on lecture basis with an honorarium of 1500/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.
 The candidates will have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistant from any agency till they are teaching in
Panjab University Regional Centre, Sri Muktsar Sahib as a Guest Faculty.
 No TA/DA will be paid for the Interview.
 Minimum qualification is as per UGC norms.
Sd/-
